title: How to organize the guest welcome and work surface | Guest Bedroom
description:
Where a guest lands the suitcase, charges a laptop, and answers the email they came to this room to escape.

This is the Guest Welcome and Work Surface in the Guest Bedroom. About 30-45 min.

WHAT DONE LOOKS LIKE
A clear desk with a working lamp, a chair pulled up to it, a luggage rack or a taped floor square for the suitcase, one labelled bin holding a spare charger, wifi card, water glass, tissues and a folded spare blanket, and a reachable outlet with no cord crossing the floor.

THE SIX PASSES
Sort: Clear the surface completely.
Straighten: Put the welcome bin where a guest sees it the moment they stand in the doorway, and set the luggage rack where
Shine: Wipe the desk and the chair seat and back, both of which collect a dust film in an unused room, and check the
Safety: The classic hazard here is the extension lead run across the floor because the only outlet is behind the bed.
Standardize: Photograph the room in its ready state and keep the print inside the lid of the welcome bin, so setting up is
Sustain: When you carry the departing guest's sheets to the wash, the welcome bin comes with you and gets restocked on

THE STANDARD YOU LEAVE BEHIND
Clear desk, marked suitcase footprint, one labelled welcome bin with the ready-state photo inside the lid, and no cord crossing a walking line.
